description: Source code for a client application that communicates with the Emergency Access Daemon (EAD) over UDP, handling authentication, command sending, and network communication.

methods.name: set_nonblock
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode based on the enable parameter.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends a packet of a specified type and processes responses with a handler function, up to a maximum number of responses.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares the password for authentication, applying MD5 hashing if configured.

methods.name: handle_pong
methods.description: Handles pong responses from the server, updating authentication state.

methods.name: handle_prime
methods.description: Handles prime/salt response, initializes cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: handle_b
methods.description: Handles the response containing a number (B) for key exchange.

methods.name: handle_cmd_data
methods.description: Handles command data received from the server, decrypting and outputting it.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to discover devices.

methods.name: send_a
methods.description: Sends the client's public key component for key exchange.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the server, encrypted.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the client workflow: parsing arguments, network setup, authentication, and command execution.
